## Lead

An unqualified person/company who showed interest: `name`, `company`, base email/phone, `source` enum (website/referral/webinar/ad/event/cold outreach/other), `status` enum (new → contacted → qualified | disqualified), `score` 0–100 (written by the Classify AI tool or by hand; rendered as a bar in isolated).

A qualified Lead is CONVERTED — the Convert Lead command creates Contact + Account + Opportunity from it; the Lead itself is a capture record, not a pipeline record.

**Non-goals:** pipeline stages/value (Opportunity's job), account linkage (a Lead pre-dates the Account existing), nurture sequences (out of scope per spec).
